# Load CSV from CIBERSORTx

After running CIBERSORTx, load the proportion results csv.  Create a meta data table to do comparisons.

```{r input}

input_directory = "C:/Users/plaisiersb/OneDrive - National Institutes of Health/Documents/Projects/Placenta/single_cell_deconvolution/Admati_2025/SingleCell/"

# read CIBERSORTx proportions
proportion_data = read.csv(paste0(input_directory,"CIBERSORTx_Job58_Results.csv"), check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1)

# check to see if any samples have high p-value 
#   indicating that the correlation between that sample
#   and the cell type signatures did not correlate well
print(proportion_data[proportion_data$`P-value` > 0.1,])

# remove the stats columns
proportion_data$`P-value` = NULL
proportion_data$Correlation = NULL
proportion_data$RMSE = NULL

# create meta data
meta = data.frame(rownames(proportion_data))
colnames(meta) = c("sample")
meta["sex"] = ifelse(grepl("_XX", meta$sample, fixed = TRUE),"XX","XY")
meta["placenta"] = sapply(strsplit(meta$sample, "_"), `[`, 1)
meta["status"] = ifelse(grepl("HDP", meta$sample, fixed = TRUE),"HDP","Cont")
meta["sex_status"] = paste(meta$sex, meta$status, sep = "_")
colnames(meta) = c("sample","sex","placenta","status","sex_status")

```

# Differential proportions

Figure out which cell types have different proportion based on sex and HDP status

```{r diffproportion}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# remove cell types for which there is none detected in any sample
proportion_data = data.frame(proportion_data[, colSums(proportion_data) > 0])

proportion_data$sample <- rownames(proportion_data)
df <- merge(proportion_data, meta, by = "sample")

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = colnames(proportion_data)[colnames(proportion_data) != "sample"], 
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  )

df_long$prop_logit <- qlogis(pmin(pmax(df_long$proportion, 1e-6), 1-1e-6))

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)   # gives p-values
library(emmeans)

cell_types <- unique(df_long$cell_type)

results_sex <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  
  df_ct <- df_long %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
  
  fit <- lmer(prop_logit ~ sex + (1 | placenta), data = df_ct)
  
  out <- summary(fit)$coef
  
  # Extract row for sex effect
  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    estimate  = out["sexXY", "Estimate"],
    p_value   = out["sexXY", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
})

sex_results_df <- do.call(rbind, results_sex)
sex_results_df = bind_rows(sex_results_df)
write.csv(sex_results_df, paste0(input_directory,"compare_proportions_sex.csv"))
#----------------
results_status <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  
  df_ct <- df_long %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
  
  fit <- lmer(prop_logit ~ status + (1 | placenta), data = df_ct)
  
  out <- summary(fit)$coef
  
  # Extract row for sex effect
  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    estimate  = out["statusHDP", "Estimate"],
    p_value   = out["statusHDP", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
})

status_results_df <- do.call(rbind, results_status)
status_results_df = bind_rows(status_results_df)
write.csv(status_results_df, paste0(input_directory,"compare_proportions_status.csv"))
#----------------
results_sex_status <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  df_ct <- df_long %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
  
  fit <- lmer(prop_logit ~ sex_status + (1 | placenta), data = df_ct)
  
  emm  <- emmeans(fit, ~ sex_status)
  contr <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "fdr"))
  
  contr$cell_type <- ct
  contr
})

sex_status_results_df <- do.call(rbind, results_sex_status)
sex_status_results_df = bind_rows(sex_status_results_df)
write.csv(sex_status_results_df, paste0(input_directory,"compare_proportions_sex_status.csv"))

```

# Plot

Create a panel of violin jitters based on the different cell types

```{r panels}

pval_threshold = 0.05

# install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)

# between groups split on sex and hypertensive status
sig_sex_status_celltypes = sex_status_results_df$cell_type[sex_status_results_df$p.value < pval_threshold]

if (length(sig_sex_status_celltypes) >= 1) {
  df_long_sexstatsig = df_long[df_long$cell_type %in% sig_sex_status_celltypes,]
  ggplot(df_long_sexstatsig, aes(x = sex_status, y = proportion, fill = sex_status)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("XY_Cont" = "lightblue", "XY_HDP" = "blue", "XX_Cont" = "gold","XX_HDP" = "orange")) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
    facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free_y")
  
    ggsave(paste0(input_directory,"celltype_sex_status_sig",pval_threshold,".pdf"), height = 6, width = 8)
}

# between groups split on sex 

sig_sex_celltypes = sex_results_df$cell_type[sex_results_df$p_value < pval_threshold]

if (length(sig_sex_celltypes) >= 1) {
  df_long_sexsig = df_long[df_long$cell_type %in% sig_sex_celltypes,]
  ggplot(df_long_sexsig, aes(x = sex, y = proportion, fill = sex)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("XY" = "dodgerblue", "XX" = "darkgoldenrod1")) +
    facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free_y")
  
  ggsave(paste0(input_directory,"celltype_sex_sig",pval_threshold,".pdf"), height = 4, width = 8)
}

# between groups split on hypertensive status

sig_status_celltypes = status_results_df$cell_type[status_results_df$p_value < pval_threshold]

if (length(sig_status_celltypes) >= 1) {
  df_long_statussig = df_long[df_long$cell_type %in% sig_status_celltypes,]
  ggplot(df_long_statussig, aes(x = status, y = proportion, fill = status)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Cont" = "darkgreen", "HDP" = "purple")) +
    facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free_y")
  
  ggsave(paste0(input_directory,"celltype_status_sig",pval_threshold,".pdf"), height = 4, width = 8)
}


```

# Simple cell type proportion plot

```{r largepanels}

library(ggpubr)

# all cell types
df_long$placenta = factor(df_long$placenta, levels = unique(meta$placenta))
df_long$sex_status = factor(df_long$sex_status, levels = c("XY_Cont", "XY_HDP", "XX_Cont","XX_HDP"))
df_long$sex = factor(df_long$sex, levels = c("XY", "XX"))
df_long$cell_type = factor(df_long$cell_type, levels = unique(df_long$cell_type))

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = placenta, y = proportion, fill = sex_status)) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("XY_Cont" = "lightblue", "XY_HDP" = "blue", "XX_Cont" = "gold","XX_HDP" = "orange")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~cell_type, ncol = 6) 
    # stat_compare_means(
    #   method = "anova",
    #   label = "p.format"
    # )

ggsave(paste0(input_directory,"cell_type_proportions.pdf"), height = 12, width = 20)

# all cell types
df_long$placenta = factor(df_long$placenta, levels = unique(meta$placenta))
df_long$sex_status = factor(df_long$sex_status, levels = c("XY_Cont", "XY_HDP", "XX_Cont","XX_HDP"))
df_long$sex = factor(df_long$sex, levels = c("XY", "XX"))
df_long$cell_type = factor(df_long$cell_type, levels = unique(df_long$cell_type))

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = placenta, y = proportion, fill = sex_status)) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("XY_Cont" = "lightblue", "XY_HDP" = "blue", "XX_Cont" = "gold","XX_HDP" = "orange")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 6) 
    # stat_compare_means(
    #   method = "anova",
    #   label = "p.format"
    # )
ggsave(paste0(input_directory,"cell_type_proportions_individual_scales.pdf"), height = 12, width = 20)

# separate cell types with high and low expression

ct_mean = df_long %>%
  group_by(placenta, cell_type) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(proportion), .groups = "drop")
ct_mean = ct_mean %>%
  mutate(high_prop = mean_prop >= 0.2)
df_flagged <- df_long %>%
  left_join(ct_mean, by = c("placenta", "cell_type"))

mean_df <- df_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(proportion),
    y_max     = max(proportion),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_label = paste0("mean = ", signif(mean_prop, 3)),
    y_mean     = y_max * 1.05   # a little above the data
  )

df_high  <- df_long[df_long$cell_type %in% unique(df_flagged$cell_type[df_flagged$high_prop]),]

df_high$placenta = factor(df_high$placenta, levels = unique(meta$placenta))
df_high$sex_status = factor(df_high$sex_status, levels = c("XY_Cont", "XY_HDP", "XX_Cont","XX_HDP"))
df_high$sex = factor(df_high$sex, levels = c("XY", "XX"))
df_high$cell_type = factor(df_high$cell_type, levels = unique(df_high$cell_type))

ggplot(df_high, aes(x = placenta, y = proportion, fill = sex_status)) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("XY_Cont" = "lightblue", "XY_HDP" = "blue", "XX_Cont" = "gold","XX_HDP" = "orange")) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~cell_type, ncol = 6) 
    #stat_compare_means(
    #  method = "anova",
    #  label = "p.format"
    #)

ggsave(paste0(input_directory,"cell_type_proportions_highprop.pdf"), height = 4, width = 8)

df_low  <- df_long[df_long$cell_type %in% unique(df_flagged$cell_type[!df_flagged$high_prop]),]

df_low$placenta = factor(df_low$placenta, levels = unique(meta$placenta))
df_low$sex_status = factor(df_low$sex_status, levels = c("XY_Cont", "XY_HDP", "XX_Cont","XX_HDP"))
df_low$sex = factor(df_low$sex, levels = c("XY", "XX"))
df_low$cell_type = factor(df_low$cell_type, levels = unique(df_low$cell_type))

ggplot(df_low, aes(x = placenta, y = proportion, fill = sex_status)) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("XY_Cont" = "lightblue", "XY_HDP" = "blue", "XX_Cont" = "gold","XX_HDP" = "orange")) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~cell_type, ncol = 6) 
    # stat_compare_means(
    #   method = "anova",
    #   label = "p.format"
    # )

ggsave(paste0(input_directory,"cell_type_proportions_lowprop.pdf"), height = 10, width = 16)

```
